'''Beolars''' was a type of industrial [[Diamond/Legends|diamond]] that could be found in the [[Mining/Legends|mines]] of the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]],<ref name="GCG" /> a [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Brema sector/Legends|Brema sector]].<ref name="SoR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> It was used for heavy [[Drill/Legends|drilling]]. The Sullustans eventually also came to use the diamond's name as a [[Gender/Legends|male]] Sullustan name,<ref name="GCG" /> with the Sullustan [[Beolars Bribbs/Legends|Beolars Bribbs]], who was elected the [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]] of the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and the [[President of the Sullustan Council]]<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_1.html|Sullustans Elect President}}</ref> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_1.html|Sullustans Elect President}} is set on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:3:7," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> being one such individual to share that name.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
Beolars was mentioned in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]'s [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
